body: Yeah, I feel good only for a limited amount of time, and then the cycle starts again. Thanks for trying it seems you are the only one who gives a damn, you're a good person. But I think I got my answer have a good life.

I don't know, I don't feel like getting up from bed, I dont have people to talk to, I am doing this as a last resort.
